lessons.title: Practice Chaitana's Colossal Coaster
lessons.description: Finish add_me_to_the_queue, find_my_friend, add_me_with_my_friends, remove_the_mean_person and 3 more. Manage coaster queues using .append(), .insert(), .remove(), .pop(), .count(), .index(), and sorted(). The test checks that add_me_to_the_queue(['Tony', 'Bob'], ['Natasha', 'Steven'], 1, 'Riri') equals ['Tony', 'Bob', 'Riri']; find_my_friend(['Natasha', 'Steve', 'TChalla'], 'Steve') equals 1; add_me_with_my_friends(['Natasha', 'Steve', 'TChalla'], 1, 'Wanda') equals ['Natasha', 'Wanda', 'Steve', 'TChalla'].
